Generated seccomp filter allowing write and fsync only for stdout and logfile_fd.

# Purpose
This generated header defines a seccomp BPF filter for `fd_exec_tile` and limits the system calls that the process can use at runtime. It allows only `write` and `fsync`, and it checks the first argument of each call so that `write` is accepted only for file descriptor `2` or for the `logfile_fd` value passed into [`populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_exec_tile`](<#populate_sock_filter_policy_fd_exec_tile>). The filter also verifies the execution architecture with `ARCH_NR` before it evaluates the syscall rules, and it kills the process if any check fails. The file is generated by `generate_filters.py`, so it serves as build output that must not be edited by hand.
